vote24.instructions: How did this person vote in the 2024 presidential election?

turnout.instructions: Did this person actually vote in the November 2024 general election?

senate24.instructions: How did this person vote in their state's 2024 U.S. Senate race?

house24.instructions: How did this person vote in the 2024 election for the U.S. House of Representatives?

biden_approval.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person approve or disapprove of the way Joe Biden was handling his job as president?

congress_approval.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person approve or disapprove of the way the U.S. Congress was doing its job?

scotus_approval.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person approve or disapprove of the way the U.S. Supreme Court was doing its job?

economy.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person think the nation's economy had gotten better or worse over the past year?

prices.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person say the prices of everyday goods and services had gone up or down over the past year?

legal_status.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person support granting legal status to undocumented immigrants who have held jobs and paid taxes for at least 3 years and have no felony convictions?

border_wall.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person support building a wall between the U.S. and Mexico?

abortion_choice.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person support always allowing a woman to obtain an abortion as a matter of choice?

abortion_ban.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person support making abortion illegal in all circumstances?

assault_ban.instructions: In fall 2024, did this person support banning assault rifles?
